scope.name: Premium File 2
notes: Japanese unnumbered promo campaign source group for the November 13, 1998 Premium File 2 rows.
This pass deepens all eight modeled Premium File 2 rows and treats the file route plus adjacent Charizard boundary as the important identification rail.

sources.title: Bulbapedia raw wikitext: Unnumbered Promotional cards (TCG)/1996-2005

claims.text: The local unnumbered-promo catalog models Premium File 2 with a November 13, 1998 release date.
The local Premium File 2 group models eight contiguous source rows: 185 through 192.
The source group is an unnumbered promotional Premium File 2 object, not a normal expansion with printed set numbers.
The adjacent source row 184 is modeled separately as Neo Era Premium File 2 / Charizard, so this eight-row dossier does not silently absorb it.
Premium File 2 matters because it arranges Johto as a set of choices and symbols: Entei as myth, Pichu as baby-era signal, Espeon and Umbreon as Eevee branching, and Unown as alphabetic mystery.

Collector attention naturally gathers around Entei, Pichu, Espeon, Umbreon, and Eevee, while the Unown letters make the object feel like an intentional Johto-language packet rather than leftover promo rows.
A Premium File 2 match should preserve the file route, the source-index range 185-192, and the exact card name together; name alone is not enough for unnumbered promo identity.

special_identification_instructions.trigger: A listing, want, scan, or agent result says Premium File 2, Neo-era Premium File 2, Eevee file, Unown file, or one of the eight Premium File 2 card names.
special_identification_instructions.summary: Confirm the November 13, 1998 Premium File 2 route and source-index boundary before treating a card as one of these eight unnumbered promo rows.
steps: Confirm the claimed card is one of source rows 185-192: Entei, Pichu, Espeon, Unown E, Unown N, Unown O, Umbreon, or Eevee.
Preserve the Premium File 2 route separately from the card name; the unnumbered promo identity is not carried by name alone.
Do not silently absorb adjacent source row 184 / Neo Era Premium File 2 / Charizard into this eight-row group.
Do not merge these rows with Neo Discovery, Neo Genesis, later Eevee-family cards, Unown cards, or legendary-beast printings without route evidence.
For transactional use, ask for full front/back photos, any file/page/insert evidence, and close images of corners, stock, and surface.
not_claiming: official product-boundary proof beyond cited catalogs

narrative.human_title: Johto becomes choice, myth, and alphabet
narrative.why_it_matters: Premium File 2 feels like Pokemon widening its grammar. Premium File gave collectors evolution lines; this one gives them forks, letters, babies, and beasts. That is a real assembly moment: the franchise is teaching collectors that a card can matter because it names a choice, a symbol, or a future language, not only because it is the biggest monster in the room.
